title: ononis pinnata var. leucotricha
intro: Ononis pinnata var. leucotricha, commonly known as White-hairy Hoof- and-horn Plant or White-hairy Spanish Clover, is a plant species in the family Fabaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to soothe digestive issues and protect against oxidative stress. The plant's therapeutic actions include its potential to act as an anti-diarrheal, anti-spasmodic, and anti-bacterial agent, making it useful in treating various gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of Ononis pinnata var. leucotricha include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
